class.name: Layer2D
class.brief_description: Represents a Ciallo compositing layer and enables offscreen rendering only when required.
class.description: A [Layer2D] can render as an ordinary [Node2D] when its settings do not require a separate layer source. Settings such as layer opacity, non-default blending, clipping masks, a material on the layer, or [member composite_mode] set to [constant COMPOSITE_MODE_ALWAYS] enable the existing transparent CanvasGroup rendering path. [b]Note:[/b] This custom node is intended for the RD renderer path. The Compatibility renderer is outside the supported product boundary.

members.member: Sets the margin used to expand the transparent composite clearing rectangle.
If [code]true[/code], marks this layer as a clipped layer whose clipping base is inferred from lower sibling layers.
Controls whether the layer selects compositing automatically or always uses the transparent CanvasGroup path.
Sets the margin used to expand the drawable rectangle of a composited layer.
Selects the runtime layer blend override. The default selection preserves the effective canvas shader blend declaration.

method.name: is_composite_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this layer currently uses the transparent composite path.

constants.constant: Uses the effective canvas shader's blend declaration.
